vulnerability.name: USN-5407-1
vulnerability.description: Gustavo Grieco, Alberto Garcia, Francisco Oca, Suleman Ali, and others discovered that Cairo incorrectly handled certain files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service. (CVE-2016-9082, CVE-2017-9814, CVE-2019-6462)  Stephan Bergmann discovered that Cairo incorrectly handled certain files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2020-35492)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in cairo. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
